**r8 (audit run 001, `docs/reviews/charger-design/run-001-2026-11-10.md`):** the adjudicated findings change no fail-safe
argument of r1-r7. Revision r8 settles seven points:

- FLT pad bridges: R106s 1.00 kOhm 1 % between U101 FLT and the F17 pad holds the FLT sink current at <= 3.377 mA, a factor
  of 2.96 below the 10 mA absolute maximum (tps2663.pdf sec 6.1), and the FLT LOW readback at <= 0.325 V (H.23(n); A.4, A.8, B.4).
- T3 timing: the REG03-05 raise write completes 1.359 ms after the edge at 100 kHz, against the 1.5 ms FR-07 deadline; the
  REG01-07 verification follows the write as four field reads, outside that deadline (H.23(o); G.1, FR-46).
- Flash and SD admission: the flash commit and the SD close have separate gates; Idle admits on battery support, and only
  the SD close and sync may run in State 99 phase 3 (G.3, FR-43).
- W1/W2 conductor: 20 AWG stranded copper, insulation OD 1.60-1.75 mm, twisted at a 20-25 mm pitch; in the modelled
  envelope the IN peak at a hard short is 33.79 V at 290 mm, against the 36 V limit (H.23(p); A.3).
- B1 riser and stacking: a machined insulating wedge B1R replaces the B1 spot and holds the trunk on the full requirement
  profile (minimum margin 0.504 mm, H.23(s)); W5 rests on the trunk, and the stack top is 20.750 mm above the MB, which is
  information under D-H (H.23(t); A.3).
- Firmware and test definitions: the FR-12(b) pin-38 criterion separates the stuck-path test from complete discharge
  (H.23(q)); the FR-48 Idle probe and the FR-23 FLT-LOW diagnostic read become explicit exceptions to the FR-23 gate; T1
  step 8b, T-B-16 and T-F-16 are restated (G.2, I).
- Traceability: every hand calculation of the r7 closing pass is a calc row of `round4/calc/r7_calc.py` revision 5
  (H.23(u)-(w)), and the TPS26630 datasheet is local (`references/Datasheets/tps2663.pdf`, K).

FR-43 (separate flash and SD gates) (G.1, G.2, G.3). It changes no pin, direction or threshold of the IO CSV. The r7

64. **T-B-16 waveform and criterion (r8, CHG-R1-08, A-05):** the run-A waveform (0.6 s at max(measured ICHG, 3.21 A), 1.4 s
    at the 1.6 A FC-window ICHG, 30 % duty) and the TDIE < 100 C criterion are qualification choices. Neither is derived
    from a measured braking statistic (burst length, burst period, braking duty) or from a transient thermal model of the
    BQ25798 on the EVM. A pass therefore establishes the thermal performance under that waveform only. The optional run B
    (60 % duty) records the TDIE reached at a higher braking duty; a run-B TDIE >= 100 C or TREG_STAT 1 is recorded here
    as the limit of sustained 60 % braking. TODO(design: braking-duty statistic from the vehicle).
65. **FR-12(b) pin-38 criterion (r8, CHG-R1-D02):** the r7 test (V_chg < 3 V within 2 s) fails for a VCHG-IN capacitance
    >= 20.6 uF, because the decay from 9.9 V to 3 V takes 1.65-2.75 s without eFuse bias current (H.23(q)). The proposed
    criterion, V_chg < 12 V after both EN readbacks have read LOW for >= 0.5 s, holds with the eFuse enabled (worst case
    0.183 s, margin 0.317 s), but it fails from >= 14.9 V with no eFuse bias current; it needs an IN-side current of
    >= 0.375 mA. IQ(ON) is >= 1.38 mA, and the IQ in UVLO and in the latched state is not specified (H.23(q)). The criterion
    stays TODO(verify: T-C-04 measurement across the initial voltage and the eFuse states). A stuck path reads >= 13.88 V
    (14.16 V with a -2 % gain error), so the 12 V threshold separates it; the battery-side ACK diagnostic stays.
66. **B1R wedge and the W-lead profile (r8, CHG-R1-D03, CHG-R1-W01):** the 65 deg ramp face is steep. Lead stiffness only
    lifts the leads above the ramp line, so the 3-D rule holds, but the T-A-06 dry fit must confirm that the leads can be
    dressed on it (H.23(s)). The 0.5 mm design margin and the 5.0 mm L-FC body height stay ASSUMPTIONs (item 56); the
    off-CR support stays TODO(design: T-A-06 dry fit). The 20.750 mm stack top above the MB is information under D-H
    (H.23(t)).
67. **Assumed inputs of the r8 calc rows (r8):** the Teensy 3V3 tolerance (+-5 %), the pin-35 pull-up range (11-33 kOhm),
    VIL (0.30 x 3V3) and the U108 output resistance (H.23(n)); t_BUF 4.7 / 1.3 us from NXP UM10204, which is not in
    `references/`, with the ISR latency outside the bus budget (H.23(o)); the sheet PSA thickness (H.23(r)); the ribbon
    thickness 0.9 mm (H.23(t)); the VCHG-IN capacitance band 17.0-28.4 uF (H.23(q)); the C102b body height 2.5 mm
    (H.23(w)). Each is TODO(verify) at its calc row.
